title: ORBIT BOARD v1.3.9: MAJOR FEATURE & ERGONOMICS UPDATE
summary: Orbit Board v1.3.9 is out with exciting additions: 2 new fonts (Agency FB & Qurova), Constellation Web effect, voice typing enhancements, spacebar customization, 3 new popups, and new themes!
highlights: 🔤 2 New Fonts: Agency FB (modern geometric sans) and Qurova (futuristic rounded typography with fixed numeral fallbacks)
🌌 Typing Effects: Constellation Web (cyber threads & Nothing Red nodes), tuned Bubble Burst (20 micro-particles), Radar Wave, and Particle Burst
🎙️ Voice Typing: System speech engine fallback, offline recognition, permission guidance, and 'Mute Voice Typing Sound' toggle
🇧🇩 Key Ergonomics: Probhat 'র' popup re-engineered (ড় center, ্র right, র্ left), Jatiyo Dari '।' shifted to Dot '.' position, and hint labels
␣ Spacebar Customization: Swipe cursor navigation, spacebar language label display/pinning with smooth fadeout
✨ 3 New Popups: Minimal wrap-content Language Switcher dialog, In-App Auto-Update BottomSheet, and Remote Announcement BottomSheet
🎨 New Themes: Taiyaki Bakery (warm toasted biscuit aesthetic), Chaos Theme, and tuned Matte Orbit palettes
🔒 100% Offline & Private: Zero network permissions, complete on-device privacy

title: VOICE TYPING: MICROPHONE PERMISSION
summary: Having trouble with Voice Typing or mic not responding? Please ensure Orbit Board has been granted Microphone permission in your device's App Info.
highlights: 🎙️ How to Grant: Long-press Orbit Board app icon on home screen -> App info -> Permissions -> Microphone -> Choose 'Allow only while using the app'
⚙️ Alternative: Open phone Settings -> Apps -> Orbit Board -> Permissions -> Enable Microphone
🔇 Click Sound Mute: Prefer silent voice typing? Go to Orbit Board Settings -> Typing -> Mute Voice Typing Sound
🔒 Private & Offline: Orbit Board is 100% offline. Voice data is processed entirely on-device and never transmitted
